desc:
🚨Auto-clicking or using macros is strictly prohibited, and will result in a ban.
You have been warned.

❓Most things you are looking for are in the Menu.
(Settings, Texture Packs, Quests, and More!)

🎮Gamemodes:
 • Bridge (Solo, Duos, Quads)
 • Basic Fight (Solo, Duos)
 • Bed Wars (Solo)
 • Bed Fight (Solo)
 • Lucky Block (Trios)
 • Boxing (Playground Only)*
 • Present Rush (Playground Only)*
 • Chaos Bridge (Playground Only)*

💪Active, casual, but competitive community.

🕹️Controls:
 • Left Click to Use Tool Function 1
 • Right Click to Use Tool Function 2
 • E to Open Inventory
 • Q to Drop Items
 • R to Change View
 • Left Shift to Crouch
 • Control to Unlock Cursor
(Keybinds are customizable in Settings)

💸We don't have P2W content, and never will.

😁Have fun playing!
